verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit and MCP server document `create_product` for catalog provisioning, and agents can create subscription plans that carry pricing. Invoice tools (`create_invoice`, `send_invoice`, `generate_invoice_qr_code`, secure invoice URL) and `create_order` offer payable-link-like flows. However, the documented Payment Link product is described as a no-code dashboard feature, not an API, and there is no standalone price object for one-time sales, so the product→price→link chain needs workarounds. Missing for 10: an API- or agent-tool-exposed payment-link endpoint, a standalone one-time price object, and a documented end-to-end single-session product→price→link flow with hands-on corroboration.
